title: Armor of Khazâd
gametext:
Bearer must be a Dwarf.
Each time bearer is about to take a wound, you may add a threat to prevent that.
Regroup: Discard this possession to take up to 2 other [dwarven] possessions into hand from your discard pile.

title: Balin Avenged
gametext:
When you play this condition, you may add a [dwarven] token here. While you can spot 4 [dwarven] tokens and 2 Dwarves, each [orc] Orc gains this text "To play, remove an [orc] card from your discard pile from the game."
Skirmish: Discard this condition to exert a minion for each Dwarf you can spot.

title: Dwarven Stratagem
gametext: Spot a Dwarf hunter and choose one: exert a minion for each hunter you can spot or reinforce a [dwarven] token for each hunter you can spot.
lore: Always well armed, a Dwarf has many options in battle.

texts: Exert a minion for each hunter you can spot
Reinforce a {dwarven} token for each hunter you can spot

title: Ring of Artifice
gametext:
Bearer must be a Dwarf. Bearer is damage +1.
Bearer is strength +1 for each [dwarven] artifact in your discard pile.
Regroup: Discard this to take a non-event [dwarven] card into hand from your discard pile.
lore: 'Beyond the shadow it waits for you still....'

title: Axe-work
gametext: Make a Dwarf strength +2 (or if you cannot spot a threat, make that Dwarf strength +1 for each Dwarf you can spot).
lore: Brave in battle, Dwarven pride and will cannot be broken.

title: Thorin III
gametext:
Damage +1.
Each time a minion loses a skirmish involving Thorin III, its owner discards the top card from his or her draw deck.
lore: Veteran warrior and keen leader, Stonehelm drove the enemy from the land of Dale.
subtitle: Stonehelm

title: Elven Guardian
gametext:
Hunter 1. (While skirmishing a non-hunter character, this character is strength +1.)
While this companion is skirmishing a wounded minion, he is strength +2.
Maneuver: Exert this companion to heal another hunter.
lore: We are proud to fight alongside men, once more.

title: Hearth and Hall
gametext: Spot an [elven] hunter and choose one: draw a card for each hunter you can spot or reinforce an [elven] token for each hunter you can spot.
lore: Until at last our toil be past / our journey done, our errand sped.

texts: Draw a card for each hunter
Reinforce an {elven} token for each hunter

title: Lothlórien Guides
gametext: Spot 2 Elves (or an Elf and an [elven] follower) to discard a condition (or discard two conditions if you can spot 4 or more Shadow conditions).
lore: The road is very dangerous.

title: Namárië
gametext:
When you play this, add an [elven] token here for each hunter you can spot.
Maneuver: Discard this or remove a token from here and spot an [elven] hunter to discard a condition.
lore: We shall not meet again, Elessar.

title: Orophin
gametext:
Hunter 1. (While skirmishing a non-hunter character, this character is strength +1.)
While Orophin is skirmishing a wounded minion, he is strength +3.
Archery: Exert another [elven] hunter and add a threat to wound a minion.
lore: Guardian of the Golden Wood.
subtitle: Silvan Elf

title: Rúmil
gametext:
Hunter 1. (While skirmishing a non-hunter character, this character is strength +1.)
While you can spot a wounded minion, Rúmil is strength +1 and gains archer.
Archery: Exert another [elven] hunter and add a threat to wound a minion.
lore: Guardian of Nimrodel.
subtitle: Silvan Elf

title: The World Ahead
gametext:
To play, spot an Elf.
Each time the fellowship moves to a region one site, add a threat.
Each time the fellowship moves to a region two site, heal an Elf.
Each time the fellowship moves to a region three site, draw a card.

title: Weapons of Lothlórien
gametext: Spot an [elven] archer and add a threat to wound a minion (or add three threats to exert three minions).
lore: Leithio i philinn!

texts: Add a threat to wound a minion
Add three threats to exert three minions

title: A New Light
gametext: Spell. Spot a [gandalf] Wizard to search a Shadow player's discard pile and choose a minion, then return that minion to its owner's hand. If you do, you may reveal that Shadow player's hand and discard a minion found there.
lore: 'I once knew every spell in all the tongues of Elves or Men or Orcs....'

title: Barliman Butterbur
gametext:
Barliman Butterbur is strength +1 for each attached [gandalf] follower.
Maneuver: Exert Barliman Butterbur to reveal the top 2 cards of your deck. Take any [gandalf] cards into hand and discard the rest.
lore: 'Barliman Butterbur at your service!'
subtitle: Red-faced Landlord

title: Gandalf
gametext:
When you play Gandalf (except in your starting fellowship), you may play a [gandalf] possession on him from your draw deck or discard pile.
Each time Gandalf wins a skirmish, you may reinforce a Free Peoples token.
subtitle: Returned

title: Glamdring
gametext:
Bearer must be Gandalf.
Bearer is damage +1.
Each time a companion is about to take a wound, you may discard a companion from hand to prevent that.
lore: ...in his other hand Glamdring gleamed, cold and white.
subtitle: Orc Beater

title: Guidance of the Istari
gametext: Make a [gandalf] companion strength +1 for each [gandalf] Man you can spot.
lore: Hold them back. Do not give in to fear! Stand your posts! Fight!

title: Gwaihir
gametext:
Aid – Add a threat. (At the start of the maneuver phase, you may add a threat to transfer this to a companion.)
If bearer is a [gandalf] Wizard, each time bearer wins a skirmish, you may exert a minion (if that minion is a Wizard, wound it instead).
lore: '...swiftest of the Great Eagles....'

effect.text: Choose a minion to exert (wound if a Wizard)

subtitle: The Windlord

title: Long-stemmed Pipe
gametext:
Pipeweed. When you play this, you may search your deck for a [gandalf] card and place it in your discard pile.
Regroup: Discard another pipeweed from play to discard a condition. Discard this condition.
lore: The smoke from his pipe drifted up, obscuring his face.

title: Meneldor
gametext:
Aid – (1). (At the start of the maneuver phase, you may add (1) to transfer this to a companion.)
To play, spot a [gandalf] follower.
Bearer is strength +1 for each other [gandalf] follower you can spot.
lore: To many he was known as the Swift.
subtitle: Misty Mountain Eagle

title: Scintillating Bird
gametext:
Spell.
Fellowship: Exert your Wizard and choose an opponent to name either Free Peoples or Shadow. Reveal the top three cards of your deck. If you revealed at least two of the chosen card type, take those cards into hand, otherwise, discard those cards.

title: Shadowfax
gametext:
Bearer must be a [gandalf] Wizard. Discard all other possessions on bearer and bearer may not bear a hand weapon.
Fellowship: Add a threat to remove a burden.
lore: There are no horses like those that are bred in that great vale between the Misty Mountains and the White.
subtitle: Greatest of the Mearas

title: The Sap is in the Bough
gametext: Discard a companion from hand to make a [gandalf] companion strength +3 (or +4 if you can spot 3 Ents).
lore: 'Together we will take the road that leads into the west / and far away, we'll find a land where both our hearts may rest.'

title: Woodland Onod
gametext: Skirmish: Discard a companion from hand to make an Ent strength +2.
lore: 'Ent the earthborn, old as mountains....'

title: Andúril
gametext:
Bearer must be Aragorn. He is damage +1.
Each time Aragorn wins a skirmish, you may exert him to liberate a site or discard a condition borne by a companion.
lore: It has been Remade.

texts: Discard a condition borne by a companion

subtitle: Sword That Was Broken

title: Faramir
gametext:
While Faramir is the Ring-bearer, at the start of each skirmish involving him, add 2 burdens or 2 threats.
Skirmish: While Faramir is the Ring- bearer, you may wound Faramir to make a minion skirmishing a [gondor] Man roaming until the end of turn.
subtitle: Bearer of Quality

title: Faramir's Bow
gametext:
Bearer must be a [gondor] ranger.
If bearer is Faramir, he is an archer.
The site number of each minion skirmishing a [gondor] ranger is +1.
Skirmish: Exert bearer twice to exhaust a minion Faramir is skirmishing.
lore: ...great bows. Almost their own height....
subtitle: Ithilien Longbow

title: Madril
gametext:
Ranger. Hunter 1.
While you can spot a roaming minion, your [gondor] conditions cannot be discarded from play by Shadow cards.
Maneuver: Exert 2 rangers to make a minion's site number +2 until the regroup phase.
subtitle: Loyal Lieutenant

title: Narsil
gametext:
Bearer must be Elendil or Isildur. Bearer is damage +1.
Each time bearer wins a skirmish, you may exert him to discard a Shadow possession.
lore: ...and the sword of Elendil filled Orcs and Men with fear....
subtitle: Forged by Telchar

title: Nimble Attack
gametext: Spot 2 [gondor] companions and add a threat to discard a Shadow possession.
lore: 'We shall be pursued as soon as news of our deed reaches the Enemy....'

title: Ranger of the White Tree
gametext:
Ranger. Hunter 1.
When this is in your starting fellowship and you can spot an unbound [gondor] companion with cost 3 or more, his twilight cost is -2.
Maneuver: Exert this companion and spot a roaming minion to make him defender +1 until the start of the regroup phase.

title: Spirit of the White Tree
gametext:
Bearer must be a [gondor] companion.
An opponent can not play skirmish events or use skirmish special abilities during skirmishes involving bearer.
Each time a Shadow player adds a burden, discard this condition.
lore: A blossom of hope.

title: Soldier's Cache
gametext:
Fortification.
At the start of your maneuver phase, you may spot 3 rangers or exert a [gondor] Man to transfer this condition to a minion. Wound that minion.
Regroup: Exert a ranger to reinforce a [gondor] token.

title: Throne of Minas Tirith
gametext:
To play, spot Denethor (or 2 [gondor] companions).
Each time a minion is killed or discarded from play during a skirmish, you may reinforce a [gondor] token.
Skirmish: Remove 3 [gondor] tokens to discard a possession.

title: Saruman
gametext:
Saruman cannot be assigned to a skirmish.
While you can spot 6 companions, each minion gains hunter 2.
Response: If a hunter minion is about to take a wound, exert Saruman to prevent that.
subtitle: Instigator of Insurrection

title: Saruman
gametext:
Aid – (1). (At the start of the maneuver phase, you may remove (1) to transfer this to a minion.)
Each time bearer wins a skirmish, you may exert a companion.
lore: 'I gave you the chance of aiding me willingly, but you have elected the way of pain.'
subtitle: Servant of Sauron

title: Throne of Isengard
gametext:
Each time you play Saruman, spot a minion. That minion is fierce until the start of the regroup phase.
Each Wizard is strength +3 and damage +1.
lore: From the heights of Orthanc, Saruman spied on Middle-earth and plotted his rise to power.

title: Beast of War
gametext:
Bearer must be a [men] Man.
While you can spot a threat, bearer is fierce.
While you can spot 3 threats, bearer is damage +1.
While you can spot 5 threats, you may play this from your discard pile.
lore: ...mûmakil were bellowing as they were goaded to war.

title: Ceremonial Armor
gametext:
Each time a [men] minion is discarded during the maneuver phase, you may stack it here.
Response: Discard a minion stacked here or discard this to prevent a wound to a [men] minion.
lore: Scarlet cloaks and bronze armor adorned the marching forces.

title: Easterling Dispatcher
gametext: When you play this minion, you may spot 2 other [men] Men to add (1) for each possession you spot.
lore: The men of Rhûn's preparation for battle was second to none.

title: Easterling Sneak
gametext:
While you control 2 sites, Easterling Sneak is fierce.
While you control 4 sites, each [men] minion is strength +1 and fierce.
lore: The dark is gathering all armies to him.

title: Gríma's Dagger
gametext:
Bearer must be a [men] Man.
If bearer is Gríma, he is strength +1 for each Free Peoples culture you can spot over 2.
Response: If a skirmish event is played, discard this possession to cancel that event.
lore: The blade of a pathetic creature.

title: In the Wild Men's Wake
gametext: Spot a [men] possession in your support area and a [men] minion. Make that minion strength +1 for each minion stacked on that possession. You may discard that possession to make that minion damage +1.
lore: Too long have these peasants stood against you.

effect.text: Would you like to discard {spottedPossession} to make {spottedMinion} damage +1?

title: Pandemonium
gametext: Play a [men] minion stacked on a [men] possession as if from hand.
lore: Few could escape the oncoming pillage of the Dunlending's savage stampede.

title: Primitive Brand
gametext:
Bearer must be a [men] minion.
Each time bearer wins a skirmish, you may transfer this possession to another [men] minion. If you do, stack a [men] minion from play on a [men] possession in your support area.
lore: The men of Dunland took even the most basic of tools to be weapons against Rohan.

title: Saruman
gametext:
Each [men] minion bearing a possession is strength +2.
Skirmish: Exert Saruman to play a [men] possession from your discard pile.
lore: Take back the lands they stole from you!
subtitle: Coldly Still

title: Stampeding Chief
gametext:
Damage +1. Fierce.
If you play Stampeding Chief from your hand, remove (3) and spot another [men] minion or discard Stampeding Chief.
lore: But no more would Rohan stand against his kind.

title: Stampeding Hillsman
gametext: Regroup: Spot a [men] minion in your discard pile and discard this minion to place that minion on your [men] support area possession.
lore: Argh!!

title: Stampeding Madman
gametext:
To play, spot 2 [men] Men.
When you play this minion, you may make the Free Peoples player exert a companion for each site you control.
lore: Death to the robbers of the North!

title: Stampeding Ransacker
gametext:
To play, spot 2 [men] Men.
Each time this minion wins a skirmish and you can spot a site you control, exhaust an unbound companion.
lore: Death to the Forgoil!

title: Stampeding Savage
gametext: Maneuver: Discard this minion and X minions stacked on a [men] possession to play a [men] minion from your discard pile. That minion is twilight cost -X.
lore: We will fight for you!

title: Stampeding Shepherd
gametext:
Fierce.
Maneuver: Discard this minion and a [men] minion with a twilight cost 2 or less from play to play Stampeding Chief from your draw deck. It is twilight cost -8.
lore: We will die... for Saruman!

title: Sunland Guard
gametext: Maneuver: Exert this minion to play a [men] minion (or 2 if you spot 6 companions) from a [men] possession as if from hand.
lore: They prepare for the last war.

title: Sunland Scout
gametext:
This minion is strength +1 for each [men] possession with a [men] minion stacked on it.
Maneuver: Spot a [men] possession and discard this minion from play to discard a condition.
lore: The Southrons did not march into war blindly.

title: Sunland Skirmisher
gametext:
This minion is strength +1 for each [men] minion stacked on each [men] possession.
At the start of your maneuver phase, you may play a minion stacked on a [men] possession as if from hand.
lore: Vile servants of Sauron marched to their master.

title: Sunland Sneak
gametext: This minion is twilight cost -1 for each [men] minion stacked on a [men] possession.
lore: Southron men were always ready for war.

title: Sunland Trooper
gametext:
This minion is strength +2 for each [men] possession with a [men] minion stacked on it.
Maneuver: Spot X [men] minions stacked on a [men] possession and discard this minion to add (X).
lore: ...legions of Haradrim from the South....

cost.text: Choose how many {men} minions to spot

title: Sunland Warrior
gametext: Maneuver: Spot a [men] possession and discard this minion from play to make each [men] minion you spot strength +2 until the start of the regroup phase.
lore: They were wicked men.

title: Sunland Weaponmaster
gametext:
To play, spot 2 [men] Men.
While this minion bears a possession, he is strength +2 for each Free Peoples culture you can spot.
lore: War will make corpses of us all.

title: Vengeful Savage
gametext: Each time this minion wins a skirmish, you may stack a [men] minion from your discard pile on a [men] possession in your support area.
lore: We will take their king.

title: Vengeful Wild Man
gametext: At the start of the maneuver phase, spot another [men] Man and exert this minion to add a threat. Then add an additional threat for each companion you spot over 4.
lore: The pawns of Saruman are relentless in their tasks.

title: Vengeful Pillager
gametext: When you play this minion from your draw deck or from your [men] possession, it is fierce until the regroup phase.
lore: Murderers!

title: Vengeful Primitive
gametext: You may play this minion any time you could play a maneuver event. When you play this minion in the maneuver phase, you may discard X [men] minions from play to add (X).
lore: Incited by Saruman, they created pandemonium in the land of Rohan.

title: Wildman's Oath
gametext:
Each time a [men] minion is discarded during the maneuver phase, you may stack it here.
Skirmish: Discard this possession to make a [men] Man strength +2.
lore: Take back the lands they stole from you!

title: A Defiled Charge
gametext:
To play, exert your mounted [orc] Orc.
Each time the Free Peoples player assigns a mounted [orc] Orc to a companion, he or she must choose to either exert that companion or add (2).
lore: The wolf snarled and sprang towards them with a great leap.

title: Chaotic Clash
gametext:
To play, spot no minions.
Each time you play a minion, it is twilight cost +1.
While you can spot an [orc] minion, each companion is strength -1.
lore: An Orc often was spurred into battle as if death was preferable to the torment of its orkish life.

title: Cry and Panic
gametext: Each time a mounted [orc] Orc wins a skirmish, the Free Peoples player must reveal his or her hand and place two Free Peoples cards revealed on the bottom of his or her draw deck.
lore: Wargs! We are under attack!

title: Feral Ride
gametext: Make an [orc] minion strength +2 (or +4 if it is mounted).
lore: It was hard at times to tell who was truly the master, the warg or the Orc.

title: Grishnákh
gametext:
Hunter 2.
While you can spot an [uruk-hai] minion, each [orc] Orc gains hunter 1 (if that [uruk-hai] minion is Uglúk, each [orc] Orc gains an additional hunter 1).
Shadow: Exert Grishnákh twice to play an [uruk-hai] hunter minion from your draw deck.
subtitle: Treacherous Captain

title: Orkish Assassin
gametext: While you can spot a follower attached to a companion, each [orc] minion is strength +2.
lore: Vile villain of all that opposed his master.

title: Orkish Berserker
gametext: When this minion wins a skirmish, discard an [orc] minion from play.
lore: These Orcs were fearsome warriors.

title: Orkish Cavalry
gametext:
Each time you play an [orc] mount, you may draw a card.
Assignment: If this minion is mounted, exert it twice to assign it to a companion of strength 9 or more.
lore: With speed and numbers, these feared riders were not easily avoided.

title: Orkish Dreg
gametext: Each time you play this minion, you may spot another [orc] minion to exert a companion for each Free Peoples culture you can spot over 2.
lore: Under the cover of darkness the Orcs came.

title: Orkish Fiend
gametext:
To play, spot an [orc] Orc.
While at an underground site, this minion is fierce and the Free Peoples player may not replace sites or play a site from his or her adventure deck.
lore: Dwellers of foul pits and tunnels.

title: Orkish Flanker
gametext:
Each time this minion wins a skirmish, if it is mounted, exert a companion.
Shadow: Exert 3 [orc] minions and spot an [orc] mount to discard a condition.
lore: Quick to contain their fleeing victims, the Orkish riders were always feared.

title: Orkish Footman
gametext: This minion is strength +1 for each twilight token you can spot.
lore: They feared their master more than any enemy.

title: Orkish Invader
gametext: At the start of each skirmish involving this minion, you may reveal an [orc] condition from hand to wound the companion this minion is skirmishing twice and then discard this minion.
lore: Spawned from terrible acts, the Orcs emerged as ruined and terrible forms of life.

title: Orkish Lackey
gametext: Maneuver: Spot 2 [orc] conditions and discard this minion from play to wound an unbound companion.
lore: They came from dark and evil places.

title: Orkish Maurader
gametext: This minion is strength +1 for each [orc] condition in your discard pile.
lore: As the Orcs silently approached, the fear they brought multiplied.

title: Orkish Rider
gametext:
Each mounted [orc] Orc is strength +1.
Shadow: Discard an [orc] card from your hand to play an [orc] mount from your discard pile.
lore: They formed the cavalry of the Orc legions.

title: Orkish Runner
gametext: Shadow: Exert this minion and spot another [orc] minion to add (X), where X is the number of the current region.
lore: Orcs were kept in check by the light of the sun.

title: Orkish Scout
gametext: Shadow: Exert this minion to add (X), where X is the current site's Shadow number.
lore: Bred in dark sorcery.

title: Orkish Traveler
gametext:
Each [orc] mount is twilight cost -1.
Skirmish: Remove (3) to make a mounted [orc] Orc strength +2.
lore: There is not much that is fouler than Orcs.

title: Orkish Veteran
gametext:
Each time you play an [orc] mount, you may reinforce an [orc] token.
Regroup: Exert Orkish Veteran to make the Free Peoples player wound a companion.
lore: Skin as dark as wood that has been charred by flame.

title: Orkish Warg-master
gametext:
Each time a mounted [orc] minion wins a skirmish, you may make the Free Peoples player place a card from his or her hand on top of his or her draw deck.
Shadow: Exert Orkish Warg-master to play an [orc] mount from your discard pile.
lore: Argh!!

title: Orkish Warrior
gametext: While you can spot a companion of strength 12 or more, this minion is strength +4. Each time the fellowship moves during the regroup phase, discard this minion.
lore: These Orcs were loathsome as Elves were fair.

title: Relentless Warg
gametext:
Bearer must be an [orc] Orc with strength 10 or less. Bearer is fierce.
When you play this possession, spot a race. While bearer is skirmishing a companion of that race, bearer is strength +3 and damage +1.
lore: The wolves of Isengard will return.

title: Rider's Gear
gametext:
Bearer must be an [orc] Orc.
While bearer is mounted, it cannot take wounds except during the skirmish phase.
lore: Foul of smell but light to bear, a warg would often allow its rider little leeway.

title: Threatening Warg
gametext:
Bearer must be an [orc] Orc with strength 10 or less. Bearer is fierce.
When you play this, you may spot 2 [orc] Orcs that are not bearing mounts to play an [orc] mount from your draw deck.
lore: 'The wolf that one hears is worse than the orc that one fears.'

title: Vicious Warg
gametext: Bearer must be an [orc] Orc with strength 9 or less. Bearer is fierce.
lore: '...where the warg howls, there also the orc prowls.'

title: Aragorn
gametext: Valiant. While the Ring-bearer is assigned to a skirmish, each [rohan] companion gains hunter 1.
lore: 'No enemy has yet taken the Hornburg. Depart, or not one of you will be spared.'
subtitle: Defender of Rohan

title: Dispatched With Haste
gametext:
While at a plains site, each mounted companion is strength +1.
Regroup: Spot 2 [rohan] Men and discard a [rohan] possession to discard a possession.
lore: Assemble the army at Dunharrow, as many men as can be found.

title: Éomer
gametext:
Damage +1.
While the Ring-bearer is assigned to a skirmish, Éomer is strength +3.
Maneuver: If Éomer is mounted, exert him to make him defender +1 until the end of turn.
lore: We cannot achieve victory through strength of arms.
subtitle: Northman

title: Éowyn
gametext:
While the Ring-bearer is assigned to a skirmish, Éowyn cannot take wounds while skirmishing.
Assignment: Exert Éowyn and assign a minion to the Ring-bearer to make that minion lose all game text keywords and unable to gain game text keywords until the regroup phase.
subtitle: Northwoman

title: For Death and Glory
gametext:
While the Ring-bearer is assigned to a skirmish, each minion skirmishing a [rohan] companion loses hunter and is unable to gain hunter.
Skirmish: Exert a [rohan] companion to make that companion gain hunter 1 until the start of the regroup phase.

title: Throne of the Golden Hall
gametext:
To play, spot Théoden (or 2 [rohan] companions).
Saruman and Gríma cannot be assigned to skirmishes.
Response: If a [rohan] Man is about to take a wound, exert another [rohan] Man and add (2) to prevent that.

title: Háma
gametext: While the Ring-bearer is assigned to a skirmish, each minion skirmishing Háma loses strength bonuses and damage bonuses from possessions.
lore: Hail, Théoden King!
subtitle: Northman

title: Into the Caves
gametext:
To play, spot 3 [rohan] companions.
Assignment: Assign a minion to Frodo to make that minion lose all game text keywords of your choice and unable to gain game text keywords until the regroup phase.
lore: Saruman's arm will have grown long indeed if he thinks he can reach us here.

effect.text: Would you like to choose more keywords?

title: Soldier of Rohan
gametext: While the Ring-bearer is assigned to a skirmish, this companion is strength +2.
lore: For ages, the people of Rohan have been allied to Gondor.

title: Théoden
gametext:
While the Ring-bearer is assigned to a skirmish, each [rohan] companion is strength +1.
Regroup: Spot 2 [rohan] followers and exert Théoden to liberate a site.
lore: When last I looked, Théoden, was King of Rohan.
subtitle: Northman, King of Rohan

title: Where Now The Horse
gametext: Spot a [rohan] companion to make Frodo strength +5. If Frodo loses the skirmish, discard that [rohan] companion.
lore: 'They have passed like rain in the mountains, like the wind in the meadow.'

title: Warrior of Rohan
gametext:
Possessions cannot be transferred from this companion to another character.
Fellowship: Play a possession on this companion to liberate a site.
lore: Rohirrim territories are not easily taken.

title: Throne of the Dark Lord
gametext:
To play, spot 2 minions.
While you can spot Sauron, each other minion is damage +1.
While the fellowship is in the same region as Mount Doom, each companion is resistance -2.
lore: One for the Dark Lord on his dark throne.

title: Halfling Leaf
gametext:
Pipeweed. To play, spot a Hobbit.
Skirmish: Discard a pipeweed from play to cancel a skirmish involving an unbound Hobbit.
lore: 'It feels good, and it smells good.'

title: Merry
gametext:
Add 1 to the number of Ents you can spot.
Regroup: Exert Merry to place a pipeweed from your discard pile beneath your draw deck.
lore: 'I think we may have made a mistake leaving the Shire, Pippin.'
subtitle: In the Bloom of Health

title: Hornblower Leaf
gametext:
Pipeweed. To play, spot an unbound Hobbit.
Regroup: Discard a pipeweed from play to remove a threat.
Regroup: Discard a pipeweed from play to discard a minion.
lore: 'These are the Hornblower brandmarks....'

title: Pippin
gametext:
Add 1 to the number of Ents you can spot.
Maneuver: Discard 2 pipeweed cards from play to remove a burden.
lore: Ents are – well Ents are all different for one thing.
subtitle: In the Bloom of Health

title: Southfarthing Leaf
gametext:
Pipeweed. To play, spot an unbound Hobbit.
Skirmish: Discard a pipeweed from play to make an unbound Hobbit strength +2.
Regroup: Discard this pipeweed from play to play a pipeweed from your draw deck. Reshuffle your draw deck.

title: Southlinch Leaf
gametext:
Pipeweed. To play, spot a Hobbit.
Skirmish: Discard a pipeweed from play to prevent an unbound Hobbit from being overwhelmed unless that Hobbit's strength is tripled.
lore: 'How it came here, I can't imagine. For Saruman's private use, I fancy.'

title: Blade of the White Hand
gametext:
Bearer must be an [uruk-hai] Uruk-hai.
While you can spot 2 controlled sites, this minion is damage +1.
While you can spot 4 controlled sites, this minion is damage +3.
lore: The servants of the White Hand laid waste to the pride of Gondor.

title: Deathly Roar
gametext:
Each time the Free Peoples player plays a possession or artifact, place an [uruk-hai] token here.
Each time an [uruk-hai] minion wins a skirmish, you may remove an [uruk-hai] token to exert a companion.
lore: The Uruk-hai assault on Helm's Deep was relentless.

title: Land Had Changed
gametext: Make an Uruk-hai strength +2 (or spot a site you control to make that Uruk- hai strength +3 instead). You may then liberate a site to make that Uruk-hai strength +2 and damage +1.
lore: 'The Deeping Wall is taken, lord, and all the defense swept away....'

effect.text: Would you like to liberate a site to make {chosenUrukHai} strength +2 and damage +1?

title: Saruman
gametext:
Each time an [uruk-hai] hunter wins a skirmish, heal a different [uruk-hai] minion.
Skirmish: Exert Saruman twice to make a companion lose the hunter keyword until the start of the regroup phase.
lore: 'He has claimed lordship over all this land....'
subtitle: Curunír

title: Saruman
gametext:
Each companion is resistance -1.
Skirmish: Exert Saruman to discard a condition borne by a companion skirmishing an [uruk-hai] minion.
lore: A new power is rising. Its victory is at hand.
subtitle: Master of the White Hand

title: Spear of the White Hand
gametext: Bearer must be an [uruk-hai] Uruk-hai.
lore: We will drive the machine of war with the sword and the spear....

title: Vile Pit
gametext:
To play, spot an [uruk-hai] hunter.
At the start of each Shadow phase, you may discard 2 [uruk-hai] cards from hand to play an [uruk-hai] hunter from your discard pile.
Regroup: Discard this possession to return an [uruk-hai] hunter from play to your hand.
lore: Saruman gazed on his creations with great pride.

title: White Hand Aggressor
gametext:
Damage +1.
While you control a site, this minion cannot take wounds, except during the skirmish phase.
lore: It's Saruman's army! The war has started.

title: White Hand Attacker
gametext:
Damage +1.
While this minion is assigned to a skirmish, each site on the adventure path gains each terrain keyword from each site you control.
lore: You will taste Man-flesh.

title: White Hand Berserker
gametext:
Damage +1.
At the start of the archery phase, if you control a site, you may add 2 to the minion archery total for each Free Peoples culture you can spot over 2.
lore: ...there was a crash and a flash of flame and smoke.

title: White Hand Butcher
gametext: Hunter 6. (While skirmishing a non-hunter character, this character is strength +6.)
lore: 'Bring out your skulking king!'

title: White Hand Captain
gametext:
Fierce.
While this minion is assigned to a skirmish, each hunter character is strength +1.
lore: They wore black armor and mail that was marked with the white hand of Saruman.

title: White Hand Destroyer
gametext:
Fierce.
This minion gains hunter 3 for each site you control.
lore: 'This is no parley. You have nothing to say.'

title: White Hand Enforcer
gametext:
Damage +1.
When you play this minion, you may liberate a site to add (X), where X is the Shadow number of the liberated site.
lore: The Uruks were tireless in the pursuit of their prey.

title: White Hand Guard
gametext:
Fierce. Hunter 1. (While skirmishing a non-hunter character, this character is strength +1.)
Skirmish: Exert this minion to make an [uruk-hai] hunter minion strength +2.
lore: Under the banner of the white hand, they came in great numbers.

title: White Hand Intruder
gametext:
Damage +1.
Each time this minion wins a skirmish, if you do not control a site, you may take control of a site.
lore: March to Helm's Deep!

title: White Hand Invader
gametext:
Damage +1.
When you play this minion, exert a companion for each site you control.
lore: There will be no dawn for men.

title: White Hand Legion
gametext:
Damage +1.
To play, remove 2 threats.
lore: The Orcs yelled and jeered.

title: White Hand Scout
gametext:
Damage +1. Hunter 2. (While skirmishing a non-hunter character, this character is strength +2.)
The roaming penalty for each [uruk-hai] minion you play is -1.
lore: 'You've got no guts outside your own sties.'

title: White Hand Slayer
gametext:
Fierce.
Each time a player plays an event in a skirmish involving this minion, that player may exert a non-hunter character.
lore: '...and there has been war between us for many months.'

title: White Hand Taskmaster
gametext:
Fierce. Hunter 1. (While skirmishing a non-hunter character, this character is strength +1.)
When you play this minion, you may spot another [uruk-hai] minion to add a threat for each Free Peoples culture you can spot.
lore: White Hand warriors fell to evil deeds with a passion.

title: White Hand Trooper
gametext:
Fierce.
While this minion is assigned to a skirmish, each hunter companion loses its special abilities and skirmish events can not be played in those companions skirmishes.
lore: ...the West is no longer safe.

title: White Hand Vanquisher
gametext:
Fierce.
This minion is damage +1 for each [uruk-hai] hunter assigned to a skirmish.
lore: 'They have a blasting fire, and with it they took the Wall.'

title: White Hand Veteran
gametext:
Damage +1.
When you play this minion, if you control a site, you may take an [uruk-hai] event into hand from your discard pile.
lore: To War!

title: White Hand Warrior
gametext:
Fierce. Hunter 4. (While skirmishing a non-hunter character, this character is strength +4.)
Each time this minion is assigned to a non-hunter companion, you may heal a hunter.
lore: Leave none alive!

title: You Do Not Know Fear
gametext: Discard a condition for each [uruk-hai] minion you can spot.
lore: Endangering and entangling all those that stood before them, the Uruk-hai shrunk before none.

title: You Do Not Know Pain
gametext:
Each time you take control of a site, you may spot 3 [uruk-hai] minions to exert an unbound companion.
Skirmish: Liberate a site to make an [uruk-hai] minion damage +1.
lore: If the wall is breached, Helm's Deep will fall.

title: Úlairë Cantëa
gametext:
Fierce.
Each unbound companion is resistance -1 for each card he or she bears.
Skirmish: Exert Úlairë Cantëa to exert a companion with resistance 2 or less.
lore: Drawn to the power of the one. They will never stop hunting you.
subtitle: Duplicitous Assassin

title: Úlairë Enquëa
gametext:
Fierce.
Each time the Free Peoples player heals a companion, you may add a burden.
Maneuver: Exert Úlairë Enquëa twice to discard a condition (or two conditions if you can spot 5 Free Peoples player's conditions).
lore: At all times they feel the presence of the ring.
subtitle: Duplicitous Lieutenant

title: Úlairë Otsëa
gametext:
Fierce.
When you play Úlairë Otsëa, you may spot another Nazgûl to draw a card for each wounded companion you can spot.
Regroup: Exert Úlairë Otsëa and discard a [wraith] card from hand to add a burden.
lore: Blinded by their greed, they took them without question.
subtitle: Duplicitous Specter

title: Ring of Savagery
gametext:
Bearer must be a Nazgûl.
Each time bearer wins a skirmish, the Free Peoples player must either add a burden or exert a companion.
Response: If a player reconciles, return bearer to his owner's hand.

title: Ring of Terror
gametext:
Bearer must be a Nazgûl. Bearer is damage +1.
When you play this artifact, you may remove two threats to take a [wraith] card into hand from your discard pile.
Response: If a player reconciles, return bearer to his owner's hand.

title: The Witch-king
gametext:
Fierce.
Each time the Witch-king wins a fierce skirmish, you may exert a companion for each companion you can spot over 4.
subtitle: Conqueror of Arthedain

title: Dol Guldur
gametext: Regroup: Exert your minion and remove a threat to make the Free Peoples player discard one of his or her conditions.

title: Falls of Rauros
gametext: River. When the Fellowship moves to this site in region 2, the Free Peoples player places a card from the dead pile out of play.

title: Imladris
gametext: River. When the fellowship moves to this site, if it is a sanctuary, remove 2 burdens.

title: Nurn
gametext: Plains. While you control this site, each of your hunter minions is strength +1.
